evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The model produces only four false positives among 984 normal test cases, supporting its suitability for high-specificity screening workflows.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on the MIMIC-CXR benchmark, using the provided train, validation, and test splits, show that CXR-CMFA achieves 93.45% accuracy, 99.88% precision, 91.8% recall, 95.7% F1-score, and 99.19% AUC on the held-out test set.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Although image-only deep learning models provide useful baselines, they discard the complementary diagnostic context available in radiology reports, while large vision-language models can be computationally expensive for practical deployment.
